player_0.content: New plan: I failed to visit all rooms because I repeatedly traversed the same path (Recreation -> Billiard -> Game -> Living -> Billiard -> Bathroom -> Cellar -> Wine cellar -> Pantry) without ever checking if I had already visited a room or if a new unvisited room was accessible from the current location. I treated every direction as if it led to a new room, ignoring the possibility of returning to previously visited nodes. Next time, I will maintain a mental (or simulated) list of visited rooms. Before moving in any direction, I will verify if the target room is already in my visited list. If it is, I will skip that direction and try another. If all directions lead to visited rooms, I will immediately output "DONE". I will also ensure the graph's "nodes" list is updated dynamically to reflect the current set of visited rooms, not just the path taken.
